summary: Decoy Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026 disclosing a warrant inducement letter with one holder of its June 2026 Series B milestone warrants covering 1,184,434 shares. The holder exercised in full on September 22, 2026 at a reduced price of $3.25 per share, down from $5.91, raising roughly $3.85 million gross. The company also cut the exercise price on its Series A and Series C warrants to $3.25 and issued 2,368,868 new five-year warrants at $3.25, a 200% reset overhang limited by a 9.99% ownership cap. Proceeds fund working capital. Watch resale-registration timing and warrant-driven dilution risk.
